INSERT INTO passkeys (
                id,
                user_id,
                credential_id,
                passkey_json,
                name,
                last_used_at,
                created_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                passkey_json = EXCLUDED.passkey_json,
                name = EXCLUDED.name,
                last_used_at = EXCLUDED.last_used_at
